name: Lumora
subtitle: Gamified trivia learning app
lead: A gamified mobile trivia platform designed to help users learn, compete, and grow through engaging quizzes, rewards, and personalized challenges.

overview: Lumora is a mobile-first trivia platform designed to transform learning into an engaging and rewarding experience.
This end-to-end UX case study covers the complete product design journey, including user research, information architecture, branding, design systems, wireframes, and high-fidelity mobile interfaces.

name: Wanderly
subtitle: Making travel planning simple
lead: A modern travel discovery and planning platform that makes trip planning simple, inspiring and effortless.
card_text: A travel discovery and planning platform that makes trip planning simple and inspiring.
statement: Discover, save, plan and visualise a whole trip in one seamless experience.

The project explores how users can discover destinations, save travel ideas, build personalised itineraries, and visualise their journeys in one seamless experience.

highlights.title: Visualise the journey
highlights.text: See the whole trip come together in one experience.

name: TravelSphere

name: CoreHR
subtitle: The future of human resources
lead: A comprehensive HR management system that streamlines HR processes within organisations.
card_text: An HR management system for scheduling, tasks, performance tracking and employee engagement.
statement: HR processes, streamlined for the whole organisation.
overview: CoreHR is a comprehensive Human Resource Management System (HRMS) designed to streamline and enhance the efficiency of HR processes within organisations.
The system aims to provide a user-friendly interface for both HR professionals and employees, supporting scheduling, task management, performance tracking, and employee engagement.
